items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: starting in 1961 I did Mike Douglas regularly, at least every month I would be on Mike Douglas’ show.

ctx.x: Johnny Carson, but also there was Merv Griffin. I did a lot of Merv Griffin. Merv, when he was here at the little theater at Times Square you know, and early, starting in 1961 I did Mike Douglas regularly, at least every month I would be on Mike Douglas’ show.
